en: A black and white postcard showing a street with a large, ornate house featuring steep, gabled roofs and intricate woodwork, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. The mansion appears to be located in a residential (villa) area. The street is quiet, with a few other houses visible, and rocky hills or cliffs can be seen in the background. Printed text in Swedish is present at the bottom.
